title: Design system preview decodes Cloudflare emails, judges a WordPress site by its own read (409 NO_SLOT, never 502), keeps the page across a device switch; the language box starts a new search after a pick; a WordPress contact link follows the template's own path; Tracy Business WP draws the site title's initials when no identity is set
steps: S3: In Add site, pick Vietnamese in the language box, press the box again and type germ.
expect: S1: every test passes: a theme named tracy at 0.1.0 with the panel's hint answers 409 NO_SLOT and reads no page; a page without the global styles block answers 409; an obfuscated address comes back as mailto; the WordPress preview runs one read per site per minute.

S2: every test passes: contactPathOf gives /about-us-2/contact for JA Nova's child page and /contact at the root; with no identity option Ánh Dương renders alt="Ánh Dương" and the mark ÁD, an empty title renders no mark.
S3: the box reads germ and the list shows German only (never Vietnamesegerm).
evidence: Measured 13/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: [email protected] in every demo preview; tracy.ai preview 502 behind a Cloudflare error page; Mobile returned to Home; Vietnamesegerman in the language box; JA Nova WP main buttons 404; Tracy Business WP 1.3.6 empty green logo square
fence: The Joomla preview path and the apply door are unchanged; a WordPress site inside its contract window still previews with one read
